en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large villa or small mansion set within a landscaped garden. The building has an asymmetrical facade with a tall, square tower on the left crowned by a steep, pyramidal roof and finial, and a lower central section with a balcony and rectangular windows. The walls show decorative brick or stone banding around the windows. Ivy climbs the lower walls, and dense trees and shrubs surround the house, framing it on both sides. The foreground is a lawn with patches of sunlight and shadow. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.
